description_en: Queries a traffic destination of an endpoint
description_zh: 调用DescribeCustomRoutingEndPointTrafficPolicy接口查询指定终端节点流量通行目标
name: DescribeCustomRoutingEndPointTrafficPolicy

parameters.help_en: The operation that you want to perform. Set the value to DescribeCustomRoutingEndPointTrafficPolicy
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的流量通行目标ID
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the traffic policy to be queried
parameters.help_zh: 待查询流量通行目标的终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

AcceleratorId.description_zh: 终端节点所属全球加速实例ID

Address.description_en: The ID of the traffic policy

Endpoint.description_en: The ID of the endpoint to which the traffic policy belongs
Endpoint.description_zh: 流量通行目标所属终端节点交换机（vSwitch）实例的名称

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the listener to which the endpoint belongs
EndpointGroupId.description_zh: 终端节点所属终端节点组ID

EndpointId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint belongs
EndpointId.description_zh: 流量通行目标所属终端节点ID

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the GA instance to which the endpoint belongs

PolicyId.description_en: The name of the vSwitch to which the traffic policy belongs

PortRanges.description_en: The IP address of the traffic policy
PortRanges.description_zh: 流量通行目标端口范围

items.description_en: The port range of the traffic policy
items.description_zh: 流量通行目标处理请求的端口范围

FromPort.description_en: The first port of the port range used by the traffic destination to process requests
FromPort.description_zh: 流量通行目标处理请求的起始端口

ToPort.description_en: The last port of the port range used by the traffic destination to process requests
ToPort.description_zh: 流量通行目标处理请求的结束端口

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint to which the traffic destination belongs

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the instance.

This parameter is returned only if the value of ServiceManaged is true
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed. Valid values:

true
false
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The actions that users can perform on the managed instance.
This parameter is returned only if the value of ServiceManaged is true.
Users can perform only specific actions on a managed instance
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: A list of action policies that users can execute on this managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the action performed on the managed instance. Valid values:

Create
Update
Delete
Associate
UserUnmanaged
CreateChild
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:

Listener: listener.
IpSet: acceleration region.
EndpointGroup: endpoint group.
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule.
Endpoint: endpoint.
EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping of an endpoint group that is associated with a custom routing listener.
EndpointPolicy: traffic policy of an endpoint that is associated with a custom routing listener.

This parameter takes effect only if the value of Action is CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the specified actions are managed.

true: The specified actions are managed, and users cannot perform the specified actions on the managed instance.
false: The specified actions are not managed, and users can perform the specified actions on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The status of the traffic destination.

init: being initialized.
active: running as expected.
updating: being updated.
deleting: being deleted
State.description_zh:
流量通行目标的状态。
init：初始化。
active：正常。
updating：更新中。
deleting：删除中
